name: Iris UI
description: Token-driven, cross-framework (React, Vue, SolidJS, Svelte) UI component library.

layerModel.description: Design tokens, applyTheme, theme store (CSS variables).

components.name: IrisAccordion
components.description: Container for collapsible sections.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: In single mode, allow zero items open.

components.name: IrisAccordionItem
components.description: A single accordion section: a button-styled header + a collapsible body. Wires `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `role="region"`, `aria-labelledby`.

components.name: IrisAdminApp
components.description: Schema-driven CMS for React. Renders `IrisAdminLayout` from a declarative {@link AdminAppSchema} (nav + pages); data pages are backed by the unified data engine (`createDataSource` via `useDataSource`), custom pages are rendered by the host via `renderPage`. The whole app is `<IrisAdminApp schema={...} />`.

props.name: renderPage
props.description: Render a custom page by key (for pages of type `'custom'`).

components.name: IrisAdminBreadcrumb
components.description: Breadcrumb trail for the admin header, driven by a `NavNode[]` ancestor chain. The last crumb is the current page (auto-marked `aria-current` by IrisBreadcrumb); earlier crumbs are clickable and call `onSelect(key, node)`. React port of the Vue `IrisAdminBreadcrumb`.

props.name: trail
props.description: Root→current ancestor chain (typically `findNavPath(menus, activeKey)`).

props.name: showIcon
props.description: Show each node's icon before its title.

props.name: hideSingle
props.description: Hide the breadcrumb when the trail has a single crumb.

components.name: IrisAdminLayout
components.description: The CMS / admin shell — a Vben-style, router-agnostic, data-driven layout that composes IrisSidebarLayout + IrisHeaderLayout with the admin nav pieces. One `menus` tree drives the collapsible sidebar nav, the header breadcrumb, and (when a `tabs` store is passed) the multi-tab bar; `activeKey` is the current page. The host owns routing: react to `onSelect` / `onActiveKeyChange` and render the page via the children render-prop (wrap it in keep-alive keyed by `tabs.cacheKey` for Vben-style tab caching).

props.name: menus
props.description: Normalized nav tree driving menu + breadcrumb.

props.name: activeKey
props.description: Active page key (controlled).

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Sidebar collapsed (controlled); undefined = uncontrolled.

props.name: tabs
props.description: Optional shared tabs store; when present the tab bar is rendered.

props.name: logo
props.description: Brand region; render-prop receives `{ collapsed }`.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Header end region (theme switch, user menu, …).

props.name: children
props.description: Page content; render-prop receives `{ activeKey }`.

components.name: IrisAdminTabs
components.description: Vben-style multi-tab bar over a shared {@link TabsNav} store. Each open page is a closable chip; clicking activates (`onChange`), the × closes, and a trailing actions dropdown runs Refresh / Close / Close-others / Close-all on the active tab. The store owns the tab list + active key; the host watches it to sync routing + keep-alive.

props.name: nav
props.description: Shared tabs store (from `createTabsNav`).

components.name: IrisAffix
components.description: Affix: pins its content to the viewport once the user scrolls past it. Top mode (`offsetTop`) or bottom mode (`offsetBottom`); the placeholder reserves the content's height so the page doesn't jump when it detaches. `onChange` fires only when the affixed state flips.

props.name: offsetTop
props.description: Pin this many px from the top once scrolled past.

props.name: offsetBottom
props.description: Pin this many px from the bottom (used when `offsetTop` is unset).

props.name: target
props.description: Scroll container resolver. Defaults to the window.

components.name: IrisAlert
components.description: React port of {@link import('@iris-ui-kit/vue').IrisAlert}.
components.example:
<IrisAlert tone="warning" title="Heads up" closable onClose={dismiss}>
    Your session expires soon.
  </IrisAlert>

components.name: IrisAnchor
components.description: Anchor: in-page navigation that scroll-spies its `#id` sections — the active link is the last section whose top has passed `offset`. Clicking a link smooth-scrolls to its section (honoring reduced motion).

props.name: target
props.description: Scroll container resolver. Defaults to the window.

props.name: offset
props.description: Top offset (px) for active detection + scroll target.

components.name: IrisAspectRatio
components.description: Aspect-ratio box: constrains its content to a fixed width/height ratio (via the CSS `aspect-ratio` property), with an absolutely-filled content layer — handy for images, video, and iframe embeds.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width / height ratio. Default 16/9.

components.name: IrisAvatar
components.description: React port of {@link import('@iris-ui-kit/vue').IrisAvatar}.

props.name: name
props.description: Used to derive initials when no `fallback` slot is supplied.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Explicit fallback string; wins over derived initials.

props.name: fallbackContent
props.description: Custom fallback content (React node).

components.name: IrisBackTop
components.description: Back-to-top button: appears once the scroll target passes `visibilityHeight` and scrolls it back to the top on click (honoring reduced motion). Defaults to the window; pass `target` for a scrollable container.

props.name: target
props.description: Scroll container resolver. Defaults to the window.

props.name: visibilityHeight
props.description: Show the button once the scroll position passes this (px).

props.name: behavior
props.description: Scroll behavior; forced to 'auto' under reduced motion.

components.name: IrisBadge
components.description: React port of {@link import('@iris-ui-kit/vue').IrisBadge}. Same visual model.

components.name: IrisBanner
components.description: Edge-to-edge announcement bar — typically pinned to the top of the layout. Distinct from `IrisAlert`: 1. Edge-to-edge (full width) instead of a contained card 2. Optional `sticky` positioning 3. Tighter vertical padding

props.name: sticky
props.description: Use `position: sticky; top: 0;`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon slot rendered before the content.

props.name: actions
props.description: Optional actions slot rendered after the content.

components.name: IrisBarChart
components.description: Vertical bar chart rendered as themed SVG over the core geometry.

props.name: gap
props.description: Fractional gap between bars (0..1). Default 0.2.

components.name: IrisBreadcrumb
components.description: Container for breadcrumb navigation. Renders a `<nav>` with an `<ol>` per WAI-ARIA. Inserts `separator` between items and tags the last child with `isCurrent` so it renders as plain text + `aria-current="page"`.

props.name: separator
props.description: String separator between crumbs. Default `/`.

components.name: IrisBreadcrumbItem
components.description: A single breadcrumb crumb. Renders an `<a>` when `href` is given and the crumb is not the last one; otherwise a `<span>`. The `isCurrent` flag is set automatically by the parent `IrisBreadcrumb` based on position.

props.name: isCurrent
props.description: Internal: set by parent `IrisBreadcrumb` when this is the last item.

components.name: IrisButton
components.description: Primary action button. Supports four variants (`solid`, `outline`, `ghost`, `link`) and three sizes (`sm`, `md`, `lg`). Each variant is styled via CSS custom properties (`var(--iris-primary)`, `var(--iris-border)` etc.) so the button automatically adapts to the active theme/skin.

components.name: IrisCalendar
components.description: Month-view calendar. Single-date selection only. Keyboard: - Arrow keys move focus - Home / End jump to start/end of week - PageUp / PageDown move by month - Enter / Space select

props.name: defaultMonth
props.description: Initial visible month (defaults to selected value or today).

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: 0–6, 0 = Sunday. Default 0.

components.name: IrisCard
components.description: React port of {@link import('@iris-ui-kit/vue').IrisCard}.

components.name: IrisCarousel
components.description: Slide carousel: shows one child slide at a time with prev/next controls, indicator dots, and keyboard (←/→) navigation. Controlled or uncontrolled. a11y: region with `aria-roledescription="carousel"`, per-slide labelling, and a polite live region announcing the active slide.

props.name: children
props.description: Each child is a slide.

props.name: index
props.description: Controlled active slide index.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap around at the ends (default true).

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Auto-advance slides. Disabled when the user prefers reduced motion.

props.name: interval
props.description: Autoplay interval in ms (default 4000).

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause autoplay while hovered (default true).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the carousel region.

components.name: IrisCascader
components.description: Cascader: a hierarchical select that drills down through columns — choosing a branch reveals its children in the next column; choosing a leaf commits the full path. Controlled or uncontrolled; closes on leaf-select, Escape, or outside click.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected path of values.

props.name: separator
props.description: Separator between path labels in the trigger.

components.name: IrisCheckbox
components.description: Tri-state checkbox supporting `true`, `false`, and `'indeterminate'`, in both controlled (`checked`) and uncontrolled (`defaultChecked`) modes.
components.example:
<IrisCheckbox checked={agreed} onChange={(next) => setAgreed(next)}>
    I agree to the terms
  </IrisCheckbox>

props.name: checked
props.description: `true`, `false`, or `'indeterminate'`.

props.name: children
props.description: Label content rendered next to the box.

components.name: IrisChip
components.description: React port of {@link import('@iris-ui-kit/vue').IrisChip}.

components.name: IrisClickOutside
components.description: Behavior wrapper: fires `onOutside` when a pointerdown happens outside the wrapped child tree. Renders a thin `<span style="display:contents">` to capture the child's bounding box without disrupting layout.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable detection (no-op if true).

props.name: ignore
props.description: Additional refs whose elements are also treated as "inside" (clicks against them won't fire `onOutside`). Useful for trigger buttons that live outside the wrapper but should still keep it open.

components.name: IrisCodeEditor
components.description: CodeMirror 6 code editor for React. Mounts the framework-agnostic {@link createEditor} handle and reconciles `value` / `language` / `readOnly`.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled document text.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial text.

props.name: language
props.description: Syntax-highlighting language. Default `'plain'`.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Render read-only (non-editable). Default `false`.

props.name: completions
props.description: Enable autocompletion popup. Default `true`.

props.name: base
props.description: Base text for inline diff view. Editor enters read-only diff mode.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the full text on every change.

components.name: IrisColorPicker
components.description: Color picker: SV pad + hue strip (+ optional alpha) with HEX + R/G/B(/A) inputs. Binds a HEX string (`#rgb` / `#rrggbb` / `#rrggbbaa`) via `value` / `onChange`.

props.name: value
props.description: HEX string (`#rgb` / `#rrggbb` / `#rrggbbaa`).

props.name: showAlpha
props.description: Include the alpha strip + alpha input. Default false.

components.name: IrisCombobox
components.description: Filterable single-select (searchable select): a text input that type-ahead filters a listbox of options. The displayed text is derived (`filtering ? query : selected label`) so controlled value changes stay in sync without an effect. Opens downward; follows the ARIA 1.2 combobox pattern.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected option value ('' = none).

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Text shown when no option matches the query. Defaults to the i18n value.

props.name: id
props.description: id forwarded to the input. Set by `IrisFormField`.

props.name: ariaDescribedby
props.description: Applied as `aria-describedby` on the input. Set by `IrisFormField`.

components.name: IrisCommandPalette
components.description: Command palette: searchable, keyboard-driven action launcher. Built on the modal-utils suite (scroll lock + focus trap). Pattern: open via shortcut (consumer wires the listener), type to filter, ↑/↓ to navigate, Enter to execute the focused item, Escape to dismiss.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Empty state text when no item matches.

props.name: filter
props.description: Custom filter; default is a tolerant subsequence/fuzzy match.

components.name: IrisContainer
components.description: Centered max-width wrapper. Use to bound content width on large screens without rewriting flex/grid plumbing.

components.name: IrisCopyButton
components.description: Copy-to-clipboard button: writes `text` to the clipboard and flips to a "Copied" state for `timeout` ms. The clipboard write is best-effort (guarded for unsupported environments) and the copied state still reflects intent.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to copy to the clipboard.

props.name: children
props.description: Idle button content (default: localized "Copy").

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Content shown briefly after copying (default: localized "Copied").

props.name: timeout
props.description: How long the copied state lasts (ms).

components.name: IrisCountdown
components.description: Live countdown to a target timestamp. Ticks every second (or every 100ms when the format shows milliseconds), formats the remaining time via tokens, and fires `onFinish` once at zero.

props.name: value
props.description: Target time as an epoch timestamp (ms).

props.name: format
props.description: Token format: DD / HH / mm / ss / SSS.

props.name: onFinish
props.description: Fired once when the countdown reaches zero.

components.name: IrisDashboard
components.description: Render a CSS Grid dashboard from a declarative config (React). Each widget is positioned using `grid-column` and `grid-row`.

components.name: IrisDashboardCard
components.description: A single dashboard grid cell. `colSpan='full'` makes it fill the row.

props.name: surface
props.description: Show the styled card surface (background + border). Default true.

components.name: IrisDashboardGrid
components.description: 12-column responsive grid for dashboard composition. Each child controls its span via `gridColumn` style or by wrapping with `IrisDashboardCard`.

props.name: minColWidth
props.description: Use `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(<minColWidth>, 1fr))` instead of fixed `columns`.

components.name: IrisDashboardTemplate
components.description: Layer 4 system skeleton: 3-region dashboard shell — sidebar + header + main grid. Built from `IrisSidebarLayout` + `IrisHeaderLayout` + `IrisDashboardGrid`.

props.name: header
props.description: Custom header content (replaces default title).

props.name: sidebarHeader
props.description: Custom sidebar header. Receives `{ collapsed, setCollapsed }`.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom main body content (replaces default grid).

props.name: cardSlots
props.description: Per-card body override, keyed by card id.

components.name: IrisDatePicker
components.description: Date picker: button-styled trigger + Popover + Calendar. On selection the popover auto-closes. Use `IrisCalendar` directly when you want it inline.

props.name: id
props.description: id forwarded to the trigger. Set by `IrisFormField`.

props.name: ariaDescribedby
props.description: Forwarded as `aria-describedby` on the trigger. Set by `IrisFormField`.

components.name: IrisDateRangePicker
components.description: Range date picker. Trigger displays `start → end`; popover contains two month calendars (current + next).

components.name: IrisDescriptions
components.description: Description list: a semantic `<dl>` rendering label/value pairs in a grid. `columns` controls pairs-per-row, `layout` places the label beside or above the value, and `bordered` draws a boxed style with separators. RTL-safe via logical properties.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of label/value pairs per row. Default 1.

props.name: layout
props.description: `horizontal` = label beside value; `vertical` = label above value.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Boxed style with cell separators.

components.name: IrisDialog
components.description: Modal dialog root. Wraps a Trigger + Content (+ optional Title / Description / Close) and threads a state machine + DOM refs + IDs through React context. Supports controlled (`open` + `onOpenChange`) and uncontrolled (`defaultOpen`) modes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open value. Combine with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open value in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Emitted whenever the open state changes.

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.description: Close on backdrop click. Default `true`.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Close on Escape key. Default `true`.

components.name: IrisDialogClose
components.description: Close button. Renders a `<button type="button">` or, with `asChild`, wraps the provided child.

components.name: IrisDialogContent
components.description: The modal surface (and its backdrop). Renders only while the dialog is open. Behaviors enabled automatically:

props.name: portalTarget
props.description: Portal target. `false` renders in place; default = `document.body`.

components.name: IrisDialogDescription
components.description:
Sets `aria-describedby` on the dialog content automatically. Renders a `

` by default.

components.name: IrisDialogTitle
components.description: Sets `aria-labelledby` on the dialog content automatically. Renders an `<h2>` by default.

components.name: IrisDialogTrigger
components.description: The element the user clicks to open the dialog. Renders a `<button type="button">` by default; pass `asChild` to attach behavior to any single element.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the single child as the trigger instead of rendering a `<button>`.

components.name: IrisDivider
components.description: React port of {@link import('@iris-ui-kit/vue').IrisDivider}.

components.name: IrisDragger
components.description: Make a child element positionable by drag. The wrapper is absolutely positioned at its parent's top-left; the position is driven by `value` / `defaultValue` (px). Drag uses pointer capture so the gesture survives the pointer leaving the element.

props.name: bounds
props.description: Constrain the position to within these bounds (px from wrapper origin).

props.name: handle
props.description: Optional drag handle (restricts the draggable region).

components.name: IrisDrawer
components.description: Slide-in overlay. Mirrors `IrisDialog`'s composition but anchors to a screen edge with a transform-based open animation. Defaults to the right.

props.name: size
props.description: Width (for left/right) or height (for top/bottom). Any CSS length.

components.name: IrisDrawerClose
components.description: A button that closes the drawer when clicked. Supports `asChild` for custom trigger elements. Emits `onClick` then calls `setOpen(false)`.

components.name: IrisDrawerContent
components.description: The slide-in surface. Mounts when `open` becomes true and unmounts `EXIT_DURATION_MS` after `open` becomes false so the slide-out transition runs before removal. Provides backdrop, body scroll lock, focus trap, and Escape / outside-click dismiss.

components.name: IrisDrawerTitle
components.description: The drawer's header title, rendered as an `<h2>`. Automatically wired to `aria-labelledby` on the content panel for accessible naming.

components.name: IrisDrawerTrigger
components.description: The trigger that opens the drawer when clicked. Renders as a `<button>` (or as custom children when `asChild`). Injects `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and `aria-expanded` for screen-reader awareness.

components.name: IrisDropdown
components.description: Dropdown menu root. Composes `createFloatingMachine` (state) with `useFloating` (positioning) used in `IrisDropdownMenu`. The dropdown panel's semantics differ from a popover: it uses `role="menu"`, supports arrow-key navigation, and items auto-close the menu on select.

components.name: IrisDropdownItem
components.description: A single selectable menu item. Calls `onSelect` and auto-closes the parent dropdown after selection (unless `keepOpen`). Disabled items are skipped by arrow-key navigation in the parent menu.

props.name: keepOpen
props.description: When true, selecting does NOT close the dropdown.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Emitted on click or Enter/Space.

components.name: IrisDropdownMenu
components.description: The menu surface. Renders `role="menu"` and handles ArrowUp/Down/Home/End navigation across child `IrisDropdownItem`s. Closes on Escape, outside pointerdown, and Tab.

components.name: IrisDropdownSeparator
components.description: A visual separator (horizontal rule) within a dropdown menu. Renders a `role="separator"` `<div>` styled with the theme's border colour.

components.name: IrisDropdownTrigger
components.description: The trigger element that toggles the dropdown open/closed on click or ArrowDown/Enter/Space. Renders as a `<button>` (or custom element via `asChild`) with `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded`.

components.name: IrisEmptyState
components.description: React port of {@link import('@iris-ui-kit/vue').IrisEmptyState}.

components.name: IrisErrorBoundary
components.description: Catches errors thrown while rendering its subtree and switches to a fallback UI instead of crashing the whole React tree. Exposes `reset()` (passed to the fallback) that clears the error and re-attempts rendering the children.

props.name: children
props.description: The guarded subtree.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Custom fallback UI. Receives `{ error, reset }`. When omitted, the default themed, accessible fallback is rendered.

props.name: onError
props.description: Invoked with the caught error (and React error info) for logging.

components.name: IrisEventCalendar
components.description: Render a month-view events calendar from a declarative config (React). Displays a 7-column grid (Sun–Sat) with event chips per day cell. Clicking a day fires `config.onDateClick`; clicking an event chip fires `config.onEventClick`. Themed via CSS vars.

components.name: IrisFieldset
components.description: Fieldset: a semantic `<fieldset>` / `<legend>` form grouping. `disabled` uses the native fieldset behavior that cascades to every nested form control — accessible by construction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the whole group (native fieldset disabling propagates to controls).

components.name: IrisFileUpload
components.description: File-upload dropzone. Wraps a hidden `<input type="file">` with a click-to-browse + drag-and-drop surface. Validates via `accept`, `maxSize`, `maxFiles`; rejected files surface via `onReject`.

props.name: accept
props.description: MIME type filter (forwarded + used to filter dropped files).

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Max file size in bytes. 0 = unlimited.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Max simultaneous files. 0 = unlimited.

props.name: label
props.description: Idle dropzone label.

props.name: id
props.description: id forwarded to the hidden input. Set by `IrisFormField`.

props.name: renderList
props.description: Custom render for the file list. Receives `{ files, remove }`.

components.name: IrisFloatButton
components.description: Floating action button: a fixed-position FAB. With `actions` it becomes a speed-dial — click toggles a `role="menu"` stack of actions (dismissed by selection, Escape, or outside click). Otherwise click runs `onClick`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Speed-dial actions; when present, the button toggles them instead of `onClick`.

props.name: offset
props.description: Corner offsets (logical: distance from block-end / inline-end).

components.name: IrisForm
components.description: Provides the form store to descendant `useField` calls and wires the native `<form>` submit to `handleSubmit` (with `preventDefault`).
components.example:
const f = useForm({ initialValues: { email: '' }, onSubmit })
  <IrisForm form={f.form}>
    <IrisFormField label="Email"><EmailField /></IrisFormField>
    <IrisButton type="submit" disabled={f.isSubmitting}>Save</IrisButton>
  </IrisForm>

props.name: form
props.description: The store from `useForm(...).form`.

components.name: IrisFormBuilder
components.description: Render a validated form from a declarative schema (React). Each field becomes an accessible native control wired to the core form engine; required fields validate inline; submit runs the schema's `onSubmit`. Themed via CSS vars.

components.name: IrisFormField
components.description: Form-field wrapper that handles the label / hint / error trio with the right a11y plumbing. Non-invasive wrapper around any Iris input primitive (`IrisInput`, `IrisTextarea`, `IrisNumberInput`, `IrisSwitch`, `IrisCheckbox`, `IrisPasswordInput`, …): locates the first valid React element in `children` and clones it with the generated `id`, `aria-describedby`, and `invalid`.

props.name: labelFor
props.description: Override the auto-generated control id.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the label.

components.name: IrisGauge
components.description: Semicircular arc gauge built from a structured SVG — a 180° track arc plus a value arc whose `stroke-dashoffset` encodes `(value − min) / (max − min)`. Distinct from the full-ring `IrisProgressCircle`.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in px.

props.name: format
props.description: Custom center label given the value and rounded percent.

components.name: IrisGrid
components.description: Two-dimensional grid layout primitive. Three column modes: - Fixed integer (`columns={3}`) - Responsive auto-fit (`columns="auto-fit"` + `minColWidth`) - Raw CSS (`columns="100px 1fr 100px"`)

props.name: minColWidth
props.description: Min width per column for `auto-fit` / `auto-fill`.

props.name: gap
props.description: Shorthand for both row + column gap. Overridden if rowGap/columnGap given.

components.name: IrisHeaderLayout
components.description: Two- (or three-) region vertical layout: a sticky header on top, a scrollable main region, and an optional footer.

props.name: headerHeight
props.description: Header height (px or CSS length). Default `'auto'`.

props.name: footerHeight
props.description: Footer height (px or CSS length). Default `'auto'`.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Header sticks via `position: sticky` instead of static. Default true.

components.name: IrisHotkey
components.description: Behavior wrapper: binds a global keyboard shortcut while children are mounted. Renderless — returns children verbatim (no extra DOM).

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Shortcut or list of shortcuts. Format: `'Escape'`, `'Enter'`, `'Mod+s'`, `'Shift+/'`. `Mod` matches Ctrl on Win/Linux and Cmd on macOS.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the binding (no-op if true).

props.name: allowInInputs
props.description: Allow the hotkey to fire even when focus is inside an input / textarea / contentEditable element. Default false (most apps want hotkeys to skip while typing).

props.name: scope
props.description: Scope: 'document' (default) or 'window'.

components.name: IrisI18nProvider
components.description: Makes a locale + message dictionary available to descendant components via `useI18n`. Either pass `locale` / `messages` (an instance is created and kept in sync) or a pre-built `i18n` instance you control externally.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale. Changes are synced to the live instance.

props.name: messages
props.description: Message overrides. Changes are merged into the live instance.

props.name: i18n
props.description: Provide a pre-created instance instead of `locale` / `messages`.

props.name: autoDirection
props.description: When set, the locale's writing direction ({@link localeDirection}) is applied to `directionTarget` (`dir` + `data-iris-dir`) and `<html lang>` is set whenever `locale` changes — so "set locale → flip direction + announce language" needs no manual wiring. Off by default so it never fights an explicit `<ThemeProvider dir>`. Reverts on unmount.

props.name: directionTarget
props.description: Element to receive dir/lang when `autoDirection` is set. Defaults to `document.documentElement`.

components.name: IrisIcon
components.description: Renders a registered icon as inline SVG. Resolves `name` through an `@iris-ui-kit/icons` registry and renders the icon's structured nodes as real SVG child elements (no raw-HTML injection). Colors follow `currentColor`, so the surrounding CSS `color` themes it. Renders nothing for an unresolved name.

props.name: name
props.description: Semantic icon name resolved via the registry (e.g. 'check', 'chevron-down').

props.name: size
props.description: Width & height (number → px). Default 24.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Stroke width for line icons. Default 2.

props.name: fill
props.description: Render as a filled glyph instead of a stroked line icon.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible title; sets `role="img"` + `aria-label`. Omit for decorative icons.

props.name: registry
props.description: Registry to resolve `name` against. Defaults to the built-in set.

components.name: IrisImage
components.description: Image with a graceful error `fallback` and an optional click-to-zoom preview overlay (a `role="dialog"` lightbox dismissed by backdrop, close button, or Escape). Lazy-loaded by default.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Shown when the image fails to load.

props.name: preview
props.description: Enable the click-to-zoom preview overlay. Default true.

components.name: IrisInput
components.description: Single-line text input with size variants, an `invalid` state, and optional `prefix`/`suffix` adornments. Forwards its ref to the native `<input>`.

props.name: ariaDescribedby
props.description: Forwarded as aria-describedby.

components.name: IrisKanban
components.description: Render a Kanban board from a declarative config (React). Columns are laid out horizontally; each card can be moved to any column. WIP-limit columns refuse drops when full. Themed via CSS vars.

components.name: IrisKbd
components.description: React port of {@link import('@iris-ui-kit/vue').IrisKbd}.

components.name: IrisLineChart
components.description: Line (or area) chart rendered as plain themed SVG over the core geometry.

props.name: data
props.description: The numeric series to plot.

props.name: area
props.description: Fill the area under the line. Default false.

props.name: nice
props.description: Round the Y domain to nice bounds. Default true.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible description of the chart.

components.name: IrisList
components.description: Generic selectable list — foundation for `IrisSelect` content, dropdowns, command palettes, etc. Implements the WAI-ARIA Listbox pattern:

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value(s). For multi mode, pass an array.

props.name: loop
props.description: Loop arrow nav at boundaries. Default true.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show the loading state instead of items.

props.name: error
props.description: Show the error state instead of items (takes precedence over loading).

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Custom empty-state node (defaults to the localized `list.empty`).

props.name: loadingState
props.description: Custom loading-state node (defaults to the localized `list.loading`).

props.name: errorState
props.description: Custom error-state node (defaults to the localized `list.error`).

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Custom render per item.

props.name: state
props.type: { selected: boolean; active: boolean; index: number }

components.name: IrisLoginTemplate
components.description: Layer 4 system skeleton: centered login page composed from Iris primitives.

props.name: header
props.description: Custom header replaces title/description block.

props.name: forgot
props.description: Slot for "Forgot password?" link (rendered next to Remember checkbox).

props.name: footer
props.description: Content rendered below the form (separated by a divider).

props.name: holdDelay
props.description: Time in ms the pointer must be held before `onLongPress` fires.

props.name: onLongPress
props.description: Called once when the hold reaches `holdDelay`.

components.name: IrisMarkdown
components.description: Render Markdown as themed HTML (React).

props.name: content
props.description: Markdown text to render.

components.name: IrisMarquee
components.description: Marquee: an accessible auto-scrolling ticker. The content is rendered twice (the second copy `aria-hidden`) for a seamless loop and animated with the Web Animations API (no `@keyframes` injection). Pauses on hover and is disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one full loop.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between the repeated copies (px).

components.name: IrisMasonry
components.description: Masonry layout: flows children into balanced columns via CSS multi-column, with each item kept from breaking across columns — for card grids and galleries of varying heights.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of columns.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between items (px).

components.name: IrisMentions
components.description: Mentions: a textarea that opens an autocomplete listbox when the user types the trigger character (default `@`). Selecting a suggestion replaces the `@query` token with the chosen label. Keyboard: ↑/↓ to move, Enter to pick, Esc to dismiss.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Trigger character. Default '@'.

props.name: id
props.description: id forwarded to the textarea. Set by `IrisFormField`.

components.name: IrisMenu
components.description: Root of a (potentially nested) menu. Provides the "close everything" channel so picking a leaf in a deeply nested branch closes the whole tree.

components.name: IrisMenuContent
components.description: Menu surface (`role="menu"`). Handles ArrowUp/Down/Home/End nav across all `[role="menuitem"]` descendants (including those inside submenu triggers). Closes on outside click, Escape, and Tab.

components.name: IrisMenuItem
components.description: An individual selectable item in a menu. Renders as a `role="menuitem"` `<div>`. Calls `onSelect`, then closes the root menu (unless `keepOpen`). Disabled items are skipped by keyboard navigation.

props.name: keepOpen
props.description: Skip closing the menu on select (e.g. for sub-actions).

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Triggered on click or Enter/Space.

components.name: IrisMenuSeparator
components.description: A visual separator within a menu — renders a `role="separator"` `<div>`.

components.name: IrisMenuSub
components.description: Nested submenu. Renders its own trigger (a `[role="menuitem"]` inside the parent menu) and floating content panel. Opens on hover (with a short delay) and on ArrowRight / Enter; closes on ArrowLeft.

components.name: IrisMenuTrigger
components.description: The trigger that toggles the menu open/closed. Renders as a `<button>` (or custom via `asChild`) with `aria-haspopup="menu"`. Opens on click, ArrowDown, Enter, or Space.

components.name: IrisMovable
components.description: Behavior wrapper: makes its child draggable. Position is `transform`-based (no layout thrash). The whole wrapper drags by default; pass `byHandle` and put `data-iris-movable-handle=""` on a descendant (e.g. a title bar) to restrict the drag origin.
components.example: Drag me by this title bar

props.name: byHandle
props.description: Restrict drag origination to a child element marked `data-iris-movable-handle`.

components.name: IrisNavMenu
components.description: Data-driven nested navigation menu — the sidebar nav of the admin shell. Renders a normalized `NavNode[]` tree as an accordion of expandable branches and selectable leaves; the active leaf and its ancestor branches are highlighted, and the active branch trail auto-expands. Router-agnostic: takes `activeKey`, calls `onSelect(key, node)`; the host owns navigation.

props.name: items
props.description: Normalized nav tree.

props.name: activeKey
props.description: Key of the active leaf.

props.name: expandedKeys
props.description: Controlled expanded branch keys.

props.name: defaultExpandedKeys
props.description: Initial expanded keys when uncontrolled (else the active trail expands).

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Icon-only rail (top-level items only).

components.name: IrisNotificationCenter
components.description: Notification-center panel for React: a header (title + unread badge + mark-all / clear) over a list of notifications (click to mark read, × to dismiss). All state lives in the {@link NotificationCenter}; the host wraps this in a popover / drawer behind a bell icon.

props.name: title
props.description: Panel header text. Default `'Notifications'`.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when there are no notifications. Default `'No notifications'`.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the dismiss button on each notification. Default `'Dismiss'`.

props.name: unreadLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the unread badge. `{n}` is replaced with the count. Default `'{n} unread'`.

components.name: IrisNumberInput
components.description: React port of {@link import('@iris-ui-kit/vue').IrisNumberInput}.

components.name: IrisOtpInput
components.description: One-time-code / PIN entry: a row of single-character cells with smart focus movement, paste-to-fill, and keyboard editing. The value is kept contiguous (no interior gaps), masked optionally, and surfaced via `onValueChange`; `onComplete` fires when every cell is filled. Drop it inside `IrisFormField` — the injected `id` lands on the first cell so the label focuses it.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value (the full code).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fired once the code fills every cell.

props.name: length
props.description: Number of cells. Default 6.

props.name: type
props.description: Allowed characters: digits only, or digits + letters.

props.name: mask
props.description: Mask entered characters (renders password cells).

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder glyph shown in empty cells.

props.name: id
props.description: id forwarded to the first cell so `<label htmlFor>` focuses it. Set by `IrisFormField`.

props.name: ariaDescribedby
props.description: Applied as `aria-describedby` on every cell. Set by `IrisFormField`.

components.name: IrisPagination
components.description: Numeric page selector with prev/next + optional first/last buttons and two-sided ellipsis. Stateless visual; the caller owns `value`.

props.name: value
props.description: Current page (1-indexed). Controlled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial page in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: total
props.description: Total number of items across all pages.

components.name: IrisPasswordInput
components.description: React port of {@link import('@iris-ui-kit/vue').IrisPasswordInput}.

props.name: showToggle
props.description: Allow toggling visibility. Default true.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Custom suffix slot (rendered before the toggle).

props.name: prefix
props.description: Custom prefix slot.

components.name: IrisPopover
components.description: Root provider for a Popover surface. Wraps the trigger and the content, threads a state machine + DOM refs + positioning options through context. Supports controlled (`open` + `onOpenChange`) and uncontrolled (`defaultOpen`) modes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open value. Combine with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open value in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called whenever the open state changes (controlled or uncontrolled).

props.name: placement
props.description: Anchor placement; may be flipped by Floating UI to stay in view.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance in px between trigger and content.

components.name: IrisPopoverContent
components.description: The floating panel rendered when the Popover is open. Position is computed by `useFloating` (Floating UI); dismissal is handled by document-level pointerdown + Escape listeners. Focus moves into the content on open and back to the trigger on close.

props.name: portalTarget
props.description: Portal target. `false` renders in place; an HTMLElement renders inside it; default = `document.body`.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Move focus into the content on open (default: true).

props.name: restoreFocus
props.description: Restore focus to the trigger on close (default: true).

components.name: IrisPopoverTrigger
components.description: The element the user interacts with to toggle the Popover. Renders a `<button type="button">` by default; pass `asChild` to attach behavior to any single element (e.g. `<IrisButton>` or `<a>`).

props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the single child as the trigger instead of rendering a `<button>`.

components.name: IrisProgress
components.description: A horizontal progress bar. Supports determinate mode (controlled `value`) and indeterminate (indefinite animation) for ongoing operations. Customisable via `tone` and `size` props; renders `role="progressbar"`.

components.name: IrisProgressCircle
components.description: Circular (ring) progress indicator built from a structured SVG — a track circle plus a value circle whose `stroke-dashoffset` encodes the ratio. An optional centered percent label sits on top. Distinct from the linear `IrisProgress`.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in px.

props.name: format
props.description: Custom center label given the rounded percent.

components.name: IrisProTable
components.description: vxe-table-style CRUD data table for React. All logic lives in the framework-agnostic {@link ProTableStore}; this component subscribes to it and renders header (sortable), selection, inline editors, rows, and a pager.

props.name: labels
props.description: Host-overridable UI strings (aria-labels + pager). Pass localized values (e.g. from the adapter's `useI18n().t`) — plugins can't reach adapter i18n directly. Defaults to English.

props.name: columnReorder
props.description: Enable drag-to-reorder column headers. When `true` every column `<th>` becomes draggable and drop onto another header calls `store.reorderColumns`. Default `false` — existing layouts are unchanged.

props.name: virtualized
props.description: Opt-in row virtualization. When `true` the body region becomes a scroll container and only the visible window of rows is rendered (via core's `createVirtualizer`), so a 100k-row table renders a handful of `<tr>` rather than every row. Default `false` — behavior is UNCHANGED (all rows render).

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Estimated row height in px (drives the virtualizer). Default `40`.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Scroll viewport height in px when virtualized. Default `400`.

props.name: columnVirtualized
props.description: Opt-in column virtualization. When `true` columns outside the horizontal viewport are not rendered, reducing DOM for very wide tables. The table container becomes horizontally scrollable. Default `false`.

components.name: IrisProvider
components.description: The single unified entry point. Runs the plugins, applies their additive token layer over the active theme, merges their messages under the user's, and exposes their stores via `PluginStoreContext`. The existing Theme / Skin / I18n providers are composed in around it.

props.name: theme
props.description: Active theme store. When passed, wraps children in `<ThemeProvider>`.

props.name: skin
props.description: Active skin engine. When passed, wraps children in `<SkinProvider>`.

props.name: dir
props.description: Writing direction; forwarded to `<ThemeProvider>`. Default `'ltr'`.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale; selects which plugin message slice is applied.

props.name: messages
props.description: User message overrides — these WIN over plugin-registered messages.

props.name: plugins
props.description: Plugins to install. Their tokens / messages / stores are collected once.

props.name: target
props.description: Element to receive plugin tokens. Defaults to `document.documentElement`.

components.name: IrisQueryBuilder
components.description: Visual query builder for React: stacked rule rows (column → operator → value) over a {@link FilterBuilder}, emitting compiled `FilterRule[]` via `onChange` (wire it to `dataSource.setFilterRules`). All logic lives in the builder.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the compiled `FilterRule[]` whenever the rules change.

props.name: addLabel
props.description: Label for the add-rule button. Default `'Add rule'`.

components.name: IrisRadio
components.description: Single radio button. Must be used inside an `IrisRadioGroup`.

components.name: IrisRadioGroup
components.description: React port of {@link import('@iris-ui-kit/vue').IrisRadioGroup}.

props.name: name
props.description: Group name. Auto-generated if omitted.

components.name: IrisRangeSlider
components.description: Two-handle numeric range slider. Value is `[start, end]` with `start <= end`; the two handles never cross.

components.name: IrisRating
components.description: Star rating with optional half-star precision, hover preview, keyboard support, and a `readonly` display mode. Uses the `slider` ARIA pattern (`aria-valuemin/now/max` + arrow keys) so it reads correctly to assistive tech; stars are decorative. RTL-safe via logical fill clipping.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled rating (0..max, in 0.5 steps when `allowHalf`).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

props.name: max
props.description: Number of stars. Default 5.

props.name: allowHalf
props.description: Allow half-star precision.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Display-only — no interaction.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Clicking the current value again resets to 0. Default true.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the slider.

props.name: id
props.description: id forwarded to the slider. Set by `IrisFormField`.

props.name: ariaDescribedby
props.description: Applied as `aria-describedby`. Set by `IrisFormField`.

components.name: IrisResizable
components.description: Behavior wrapper: makes its child resizable via 8-direction handles. The wrapper itself is `display: inline-block; position: relative` so the child can be ANY element (no need for the child to know it's wrapped). Handles are absolutely positioned over the wrapper's edges.

props.name: size
props.description: Controlled size.

components.name: IrisResizer
components.description: 8-direction resizer wrapping a single child element. The child is rendered inside a relatively positioned wrapper; handles overlay each side and corner. Drag updates `value` ({ width, height } in px) clamped by min/max.

props.name: keepAspect
props.description: Maintain `width / height` ratio when dragging corner handles.

components.name: IrisResult
components.description: Result: a centered outcome page for an operation — a status icon, title, subtitle, action area, and optional content. Use for success / error / 404 / 403 / 500 screens. Pure presentation; the status glyph is decorative.

props.name: icon
props.description: Override the default status glyph/icon.

props.name: extra
props.description: Action area (e.g. buttons) below the text.

props.name: children
props.description: Additional content (e.g. error details).

components.name: IrisRibbon
components.description: Ribbon: a corner badge ("New", "Sale", …) anchored to the top corner of its content. RTL-safe via logical insets/radii.

props.name: placement
props.description: Corner: 'end' = top inline-end (default), 'start' = top inline-start.

props.name: color
props.description: Badge background (defaults to the primary color).

components.name: IrisScrollArea
components.description: Scroll area: a keyboard-focusable scroll container that constrains its content via `maxHeight` / `maxWidth` and scrolls on the chosen `axis`. A lightweight alternative to ad-hoc overflow styling.

components.name: IrisSegmented
components.description: Segmented control: a connected row of single-select segments with the active one visually raised. Radiogroup semantics with roving tabindex and Arrow / Home / End keyboard navigation — single-sourced in `createKeyboardNav`.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch to fill the container width.

components.name: IrisSelect
components.description: Single-select dropdown. Composes Popover (positioning + dismiss) with an inline listbox (keyboard nav + selection). Arrow-key, typeahead, Home/End, and Enter/Space navigation are single-sourced in `createKeyboardNav` (core).
components.example:
<IrisSelect
    items={[{ value: 'a', label: 'Apple' }, { value: 'b', label: 'Banana' }]}
    value={fruit}
    onValueChange={setFruit}
    placeholder="Pick a fruit"
  />

props.name: id
props.description: id forwarded to the trigger button. Set by `IrisFormField`.

props.name: ariaDescribedby
props.description: Forwarded as `aria-describedby` on the trigger. Set by `IrisFormField`.

props.name: renderTrigger
props.type: (state: { value: T | undefined; label: string; open: boolean }) => React.ReactNode
props.description: Custom render for the trigger button. Receives current label + open state.

components.name: IrisSidebarLayout
components.description: Two-column layout with a collapsible sidebar. The sidebar is kept mounted across collapses (only its width animates) so component state survives.

props.name: width
props.description: Sidebar width when expanded (px or CSS length).

props.name: collapsedWidth
props.description: Sidebar width when collapsed.

props.name: sidebar
props.description: Sidebar content. May be a render function that receives `{ collapsed, setCollapsed }`.

components.name: IrisSkeleton
components.description: A placeholder shape that pulses to indicate content is loading. Supports `rect`, `circle`, and `text` shapes with configurable dimensions. Its shimmer animation respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.

components.name: IrisSlider
components.description: Numeric slider with keyboard + pointer support.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for screen readers.

components.name: IrisSlot
components.description: asChild composition primitive: clones the single React element child and merges the Slot's own props into it. `style` shallow-merges, `className` concatenates, event handlers compose (Slot's first, then child's), and any other prop on the child wins over Slot's. Used as a building block for trigger primitives that want to render-as the consumer's chosen element.

components.name: IrisSparkline
components.description: Compact, axis-less inline trend line (for tables / stat cards).

components.name: IrisSpinner
components.description: React port of {@link import('@iris-ui-kit/vue').IrisSpinner}.

components.name: IrisSplitButton
components.description: Split button: a primary action joined to a caret that opens a `role="menu"` of secondary actions (dismissed by selection, Escape, or outside click).

components.name: IrisSplitter
components.description: Two-pane splitter with a draggable divider. The split position is a number in `[0, 1]`. Clamping respects `minStart` / `minEnd` (in px) so panes cannot collapse below a usable size.

props.name: value
props.description: Split ratio in [0, 1].

props.name: minStart
props.description: Minimum size of the start pane in px.

props.name: minEnd
props.description: Minimum size of the end pane in px.

props.name: start
props.description: Start pane content.

props.name: end
props.description: End pane content.

components.name: IrisStack
components.description: Flex container with token-driven spacing. The lightest possible layout primitive — saves hand-writing `display: flex` everywhere.

props.name: inline
props.description: When true, renders as `inline-flex`.

components.name: IrisStatistic
components.description: Compact statistic / KPI display: a label, a prominent value (with optional prefix/suffix), an optional colored trend line, and a description. Pure presentation; the trend glyph is decorative (aria-hidden) — the magnitude text carries the meaning.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Rendered before the value (e.g. a currency sign).

props.name: suffix
props.description: Rendered after the value (e.g. a unit).

props.name: trend
props.description: Trend direction — colors the trend line and shows a ▲/▼ glyph.

props.name: trendValue
props.description: Trend magnitude text (e.g. "12%").

components.name: IrisStepper
components.description: Multi-step flow container. Children should be `IrisStepperStep`s; each registers itself with the stepper's context and self-renders its indicator + title.

props.name: linear
props.description: When true (default), forward navigation is blocked beyond the current step.

components.name: IrisStepperStep
components.description: A single step in an {@link IrisStepper}. Auto-numbers based on its position in the document order (registers on mount). Click forwards through `goTo` which gates by `linear`.

props.name: status
props.description: Force a status; otherwise computed from position vs current.

components.name: IrisSwitch
components.description: Toggle switch for an on/off boolean, in controlled (`checked`) or uncontrolled (`defaultChecked`) modes. Rendered with `role="switch"`.

components.name: IrisTable
components.description: Data-driven table. Renders as a CSS-grid layout (no native `<table>`) so it can support future virtual scroll / column resize uniformly. Wires ARIA roles (`table` / `row` / `columnheader` / `cell`) for screen readers.

props.name: rowKey
props.description: Field to use as the row key.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Selection mode.

props.name: resizableColumns
props.description: Enable column resizing (drag the header's trailing edge or focus + arrow keys).

props.name: columnWidths
props.description: Controlled per-column pixel widths, keyed by column `key`.

props.name: onCellEdit
props.description: Called when an inline-editable cell is committed with a changed value.

props.name: renderDetail
props.description: Render an expandable detail panel beneath a row. Providing this adds a leading expand-toggle column; clicking it reveals a full-width detail row. (Not applied in the virtual-scroll path.)

props.name: rowExpandable
props.description: Which rows can expand a detail panel. Defaults to all rows when `renderDetail` is set.

props.name: defaultExpandedRowKeys
props.description: Initially-expanded row keys (uncontrolled). Shared by detail rows + tree rows.

props.name: onExpandedRowsChange
props.description: Notified with the expanded row keys whenever they change.

props.name: getSubRows
props.description: Read a row's child rows to render the table as a TREE. Providing this enables tree mode: `data` is treated as the root rows, each row's first cell gains a depth indent + an expand/collapse toggle (when it has children), and the expand state reuses `defaultExpandedRowKeys`/`onExpandedRowsChange`. Column sort reorders siblings hierarchically (each level sorted, structure kept), and tree rows virtualize like flat rows when `virtualScroll` is set (unless `renderDetail` is also used, since detail panels are variable-height).

props.name: keyboardNavigation
props.description: Enable WAI-ARIA grid keyboard navigation: the table becomes `role="grid"` and Arrow / Home / End / Page Up·Down move a roving cell focus across the data cells. Off by default; opt-in and additive (no effect on mouse / Tab behavior). Pairs best without virtualization (the focused cell must be rendered) and does not hijack keystrokes while a cell is being edited.

props.name: virtualScroll
props.description: Enable virtual scrolling for the body (renders only the visible window).

props.name: columnVirtualization
props.description: Render only the horizontally-visible columns (plus pinned + a small overscan) for very wide tables. Needs numeric column widths; the table becomes a horizontal scroll container. Off-screen grid tracks stay sized, so alignment, resize, and pinned columns keep working.

props.name: cellRange
props.description: Enable rectangular cell-range selection (Excel-style). Click starts a range; Shift+Click or Shift+Arrow extends it; Escape clears it. Cells within the range get `data-iris-cell-selected="true"`.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Empty state node (replaces the row body when `data` is empty).

props.name: loading
props.description: Show the loading state instead of rows.

props.name: error
props.description: Show the error state instead of rows (takes precedence over loading).

props.name: loadingState
props.description: Custom loading-state node (defaults to the localized `table.loading`).

props.name: errorState
props.description: Custom error-state node (defaults to the localized `table.error`).

components.name: IrisTabs
components.description: Tabs root. Provides context for value, orientation, lazy mounting, and the ordered set of registered triggers so arrow-key navigation can move focus deterministically (skipping disabled triggers).
components.example:
<IrisTabs defaultValue="a">
    <IrisTabsList>
      <IrisTabsTrigger value="a">First</IrisTabsTrigger>
      <IrisTabsTrigger value="b">Second</IrisTabsTrigger>
    </IrisTabsList>
    <IrisTabsContent value="a">Panel A</IrisTabsContent>
    <IrisTabsContent value="b">Panel B</IrisTabsContent>
  </IrisTabs>

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled active value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial active value in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: lazy
props.description: When true (default), content panels are unmounted when not active.

components.name: IrisTabsContent
components.description: Panel paired with a `IrisTabsTrigger` by matching `value`. When `lazy` is true on the parent (default), inactive panels are unmounted. Pass `forceMount` to always render (e.g. for SEO or pre-warming).

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Render even when inactive; hidden via the `hidden` attribute.

components.name: IrisTabsList
components.description: Container for `IrisTabsTrigger`s. Renders `<div role="tablist">`.

components.name: IrisTabsTrigger
components.description: A single tab button. Registers with the parent `IrisTabs` so arrow keys can navigate among triggers in registration order. Sets `aria-selected` and `aria-controls`; uses roving tabindex.

components.name: IrisTagInput
components.description: Tag / token input: a field where typed text becomes removable chips. Commit a tag with Enter or a comma (pasted comma lists split too); Backspace on an empty input removes the last tag; each chip has a remove button.

props.name: max
props.description: Max number of tags. 0 / undefined = unlimited.

props.name: id
props.description: id forwarded to the input. Set by `IrisFormField`.

components.name: IrisTextarea
components.description: Multi-line text input with size variants and an `invalid` state. Optionally grows to fit its content when `autosize` is set, capped at `maxRows`.

components.name: IrisTimeline
components.description: Vertical event timeline: an ordered list of items, each with a colored dot, a connector line (omitted on the last item), and time/title/description content (or a custom `renderItem`). Semantic `<ol>` for assistive tech; RTL-safe via logical properties.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Replace the default content (time/title/description) for every item.

components.name: IrisTimePicker
components.description: Time picker rendered as two zero-padded number inputs (hours + minutes) plus an optional AM/PM toggle for 12h format. Internal value is always 24-hour `{ hours, minutes }`.

props.name: minuteStep
props.description: Step in minutes for the minute input (1, 5, 10, 15, 30).

props.name: id
props.description: id forwarded to the hours input. Set by `IrisFormField`.

props.name: ariaDescribedby
props.description: Forwarded as `aria-describedby` on the hours input. Set by `IrisFormField`.

components.name: IrisToastViewport
components.description: Renders the queued toasts. Mount exactly **one** of these per page. The viewport subscribes to the module-level toast store; toasts pushed via `useToast()` from any component appear here.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum simultaneous toasts; older entries are evicted when exceeded.

components.name: IrisToggleGroup
components.description: Segmented control. Two modes: - `type="single"` — radio-like; value is `string | null`. Root gets `role="radiogroup"`, items get `role="radio"` + `aria-checked`. - `type="multiple"` — toggle-like; value is `string[]`. Root gets `role="group"`, items get `aria-pressed`.

components.name: IrisToggleGroupItem
components.description: One toggle in an `IrisToggleGroup`. Renders a `<button>` with the correct `role` / `aria-checked` / `aria-pressed` for the group's type.

components.name: IrisToolbar
components.description: Toolbar: a `role="toolbar"` grouping of actions with roving-tabindex keyboard navigation — one item is in the tab order, and Arrow keys (per orientation) plus Home/End move focus and the tab stop between the focusable children.

components.name: IrisTooltip
components.description: Hover / focus triggered tooltip. Powered by `createHoverIntent` state machine.

props.name: content
props.description: Plain-text tooltip content.

props.name: placement
props.description: Side relative to the trigger; may flip to stay in view.

props.name: offset
props.description: Pixel offset between trigger and tooltip.

props.name: openDelay
props.description: Hover/focus dwell before opening, in ms.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Hover/blur dwell before closing, in ms.

props.name: portalTarget
props.description: Portal target. `false` renders in place; an HTMLElement renders inside it; default = `document.body`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the tooltip without removing the trigger.

components.name: IrisTour
components.description: Guided tour: an overlay that walks the user through `steps`, spotlighting an optional target per step and showing a dialog card with prev/next/skip controls. Controlled (`open`) or uncontrolled (`defaultOpen`); the step index is managed internally and resets each time the tour opens.

components.name: IrisTransfer
components.description: Dual-list transfer: move items between an "available" and a "selected" pane via per-item checkboxes and the ›/‹ buttons. Controlled or uncontrolled (`value` = the selected values), with optional per-pane search and a select-all header. Built on native checkboxes for accessibility.

props.name: value
props.description: Values currently in the target (selected) pane.

props.name: titles
props.description: Pane titles: [available, selected].

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show a search box per pane.

components.name: IrisTree
components.description: Tree control. Renders a hierarchy of `IrisTreeNode`s with expand/collapse, single/multi selection, and optional lazy-loaded children. WAI-ARIA Tree pattern: root `role="tree"`, each node `role="treeitem"`, roving tabindex.

props.name: checkable
props.description: Show a checkbox per node with parent/child cascade + indeterminate (tri-state) propagation, independent of `selectionMode`. Driven by the framework-agnostic `createTreeSelection`.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initially checked node ids (uncontrolled; reconciled through the cascade).

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Notified with the fully-reconciled checked node ids on every check change.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show the loading state instead of nodes.

props.name: error
props.description: Show the error state instead of nodes (takes precedence over loading).

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Custom empty-state node (defaults to the localized `tree.empty`).

props.name: loadingState
props.description: Custom loading-state node (defaults to the localized `tree.loading`).

props.name: errorState
props.description: Custom error-state node (defaults to the localized `tree.error`).

components.name: IrisTreeSelect
components.description: Hierarchical single-select: a trigger that opens a `role="tree"` dropdown with expand/collapse toggles. Selecting a node sets the value and closes. Controlled or uncontrolled; closes on select, Escape, or outside click.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Node values expanded by default.

props.name: id
props.description: id forwarded to the trigger. Set by `IrisFormField`.

components.name: IrisVirtualScroll
components.description: Virtual scroller. Renders only the visible window of items plus a configurable buffer above and below. Vertical-only. `itemHeight` may be a fixed number, a `(index) => px` function for variable-height rows, or `'auto'` to measure rendered rows.

props.name: itemHeight
props.description: Per-item height in px. A number means every row shares that height; pass a `(index) => px` function for known variable heights (memoize it); or `'auto'` to measure rendered rows via `ResizeObserver` and cache them — no need to know heights ahead of time (wrapped text, expandable rows).

props.name: estimatedItemHeight
props.description: Initial row-height estimate used before measurement, when `itemHeight="auto"`.

props.name: height
props.description: Viewport height. Number → px; string → CSS length passed through.

props.name: buffer
props.description: Number of extra rows to render above and below the viewport.

props.name: keyOf
props.description: Stable key per item. Falls back to index.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Render a single item.

components.name: IrisVisuallyHidden
components.description: Visually-hidden content: present in the accessibility tree (read by screen readers) but clipped from view — for labels, live-region announcements, and extra context. Forwards attributes like `aria-live` / `role`.

components.name: IrisWatermark
components.description: Watermark: overlays tiled, rotated text over its content — for confidential or branded surfaces. The overlay is `aria-hidden`, non-selectable, and `pointer-events: none`, so it never interferes with the underlying UI. Built from structured `<span>` nodes (no raw HTML / canvas / SVG-string injection).

props.name: content
props.description: Watermark text, tiled across the area.

props.name: children
props.description: Content the watermark overlays.

props.name: rotate
props.description: Rotation of each tile in degrees.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Overlay opacity (0–1).

props.name: gap
props.description: Spacing between tiles in px.
